name: @djgrant/hmux
description: A harness multiplexer built on top of tmux: jump between agent sessions and see what's happening inside them

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/cli.js --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js --external terminal-focus && bun build ../server/src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/server.js
